:::{#thm-log-partition-mean}
#### The mean of the statistic is the derivative of the log-partition function

Let $\Rvar$ have a [distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) in an [exponential family](#def-exponential-family)
with [natural parameter](#def-natural-parameter) $\natparam$,
[statistic](sufficiency.qmd#def-statistic) $\stat$,
and log-partition function $\logpartition$,
and let $\natparam$ be in the interior of the allowed values.
Then

$$
\E{\statf{\Rvar}} = \dif{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}{\natparam}.
$$

:::

::: proof

The identity is the solution to @exr-log-partition-derivative,
worked in @sol-log-partition-derivative,
which uses the solution to @exr-log-partition-normalization,
worked in @sol-log-partition-normalization.

:::
